title: Font Pipeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Custom Fonts
font_to_py
Writer
Memory
description: Follow the steps from a TrueType font on your computer to large text on the OLED, and estimate how much memory a font module needs.

learningObjectives: Describe the steps from a font file to text on the OLED
Identify which steps run on the computer and which run on the Pico
Estimate how font height and character count affect memory use
prerequisites: Text rendering with the built-in 8 by 8 font (Chapter 12)

keyQuestions: Why can the Pico not use a .ttf file directly?
Why does a taller font cost more than twice the memory?
commonMisconceptions: The Pico converts fonts itself (conversion happens on your computer)
A font takes the same memory no matter which characters it holds
assessmentOpportunities: The student explains that font_to_py.py runs on the computer, not the Pico.
The student explains why -c 0123456789: keeps the module small.
The student estimates that doubling the height roughly triples or quadruples the bitmap size.
